score.scope: Still-image craft within silent action legibility, hierarchy, atmosphere and visual rest across the entire frame. No audio or motion score.

deductions.location: Hero cream head/wing and bench across right half; canopy, support beams and ground around central workshop
deductions.finding: 11 spreads a sharper patch/facet-like edge network across otherwise soft or smoothly lit surfaces. The hero face and bench plank surfaces are visibly more broken up than07, and similar small patches recur on the canopy/beam. This reduces calm around the strongest face and makes different materials compete at the same detail frequency.
deductions.basis: Direct visual comparison, not an assumption that repeated edits must degrade art.07 also has handcrafted texture; the objection is the stronger edge network and material homogenization in11, not all texture.
deductions.improvementCriterion: Quiet the unintended patch boundaries on the hero face and wood/fabric planes while retaining fur, grain and weave appropriate to each. Verify the whole native frame and1280/880 views still feel cohesive, not just the repaired area.

deductions.location: Workshop moth hand and mallet handle, around x900,y275 in full frame
deductions.finding: The mallet support in11 reads as a narrow angular pale/dark wedge around the handle.07 has a more immediately readable rounded mitten gripping it. The thin angular join makes the central making action less physically clear even though the broad mallet-and-box story survives.
deductions.basis: Visible contact/silhouette readability judgment; not an animation, force or anatomical simulation result.
deductions.improvementCriterion: Restore a small rounded attached mitten and unambiguous handle grip without lengthening the arm, changing the action or enlarging the workshop cast.

criteriaForNine: Clean the two named visible weaknesses while preserving the warm composition, varied material cues and original tiny character proportions.
At native and1280/880 widths, keep the hero face as the clearest quiet shape; allow background texture to support depth rather than compete with it.
Keep bench coding dominant, workshop making readable, and the authorized leaf-play group visibly subordinate; do not add sound or attention marks to repair visual cause.
Reinspect the full finished candidate and magnified eye/contact details after any cleanup; isolated repair approval does not establish a9 whole-frame result.

strengths: The coding moth remains the first read through scale, large cream head, foreground placement and the readable laptop/hand relationship. Guests stay out of the coding bench and path foreground.
The path and open center separate the three moth activities instead of arranging them as a logo strip. The large tree and bench frame the scene, while the distant bridge/water create useful depth.

Warm directional light, foliage edges, shaded tree root and softly distant landscape make a coherent welcoming atmosphere across the environment as well as the characters. No soundtrack is needed to establish that mood.

Muse/Grok playing with one leaf directly in front of the resting moth is the current authorized tree-local arrangement. It is subordinate to the coding hero and is not rejected by the earlier blanket foreground wording.
The workshop observers on stools are integrated as spectators at a believable scale. Their smaller faces do not displace the main moth.

At420px the hero and broad three-zone composition remain identifiable, while guest identities and hand/tool detail collapse into accents. This is an honest scale limit, not proof of phone comprehension.

The required enlarged crop shows dark Muse eyes and flat white Grok ovals without an obvious dark pupil. That scoped correction is useful; it does not settle the whole-frame material/contact concerns.

mustFix.reason: Before calling11 finished at the requested whole-image craft level, restore deliberate material hierarchy and quiet planes where the current patch network distracts from face/action.
The making vignette should show a clearly attached tiny hand holding its tool; the current angular join is avoidable silent-action ambiguity.

optional.location: Bright grass/path/flower speckles around the central clearing
optional.suggestion: If one further restrained pass is justified, reduce a few isolated high-contrast speckles near the path rather than dimming the whole scene. Existing warm atmosphere is a strength; this is taste refinement, not a separate defect.

baselineComparison: 07 and11 retain substantially the same effective composition.11 enlarges/clarifies the flat Grok eyes and modifies the workshop pose; its whole-frame retouch also makes head, bench and workshop surfaces visibly patchier.07 has a calmer hero face/material read and clearer small mallet grip. Use07 as a focused texture/contact control while keeping authorized current story and corrected eyes, not as an automatic wholesale rollback.
